title: A real API-key walkthrough
label: CHOOSE ONE PROVIDER
text: Here are three ways to connect a free tier language model to Firebrat. Pick just one provider.

title: 1 / OpenRouter
label: openrouter.ai → API Keys
text: On Open Router, sign in, open API Keys, and choose New Key.

title: Name your key
label: New Key → Firebrat → Create
text: Name it Firebrat. Choose an expiration and a spending limit that suits you, then create the key. Copy it privately. In Firebrat, choose a free model, such as Open Router slash free.

title: 2 / Google AI Studio
label: aistudio.google.com → Get API key
text: For Gemini, open Google A I Studio and choose Get API key. Check that your project shows Free tier.

title: Choose your own project
label: Create API key → Name → Project
text: Choose Create API key. Name it Firebrat, select a project you own, and create the key. If your project is missing, import it first. Copy the key privately.

title: 3 / GroqCloud
label: console.groq.com → API Keys
text: On Groq Cloud, sign in and open API Keys. Choose Create API Key.

title: Create your Groq key
label: Display Name → Expiration → Submit
text: Enter Firebrat as the display name, choose an expiration, then submit. Copy your new key. You do not need to upgrade the plan for this walkthrough.

title: Finish in Firebrat
label: Conversion settings → LLM
text: In Firebrat's conversion settings, paste the matching base address and your key. Load models, choose an available text model, then test the connection. Use the addresses in the description.

title: Free tier ≠ unlimited
label: LIMITS · PRIVACY · KEEP KEYS SECRET
text: Free tiers have usage limits, regional restrictions, and provider data policies. Never share your key. These providers process language requests; Firebrat's narration can still run locally. Fully offline conversion needs no cloud key.
